name: arxa-theme-accent
description: Settings > Personalisation accent swatches (3 fixed choices) + the Editor font row (both moved from General in 0.2.5 when the Personalisation tab arrived). Overrides the dsh --dsw-static-deepseek-* accent scale with color-mix tints of the chosen hex, inline on <body> so it wins over both the :root and dark-theme token blocks. Persisted in localStorage, synced across tabs/windows via the storage event.
